scripts.predev: clear && echo '🚀 Starting Nexom Microservices...' && echo '-----------------------------------'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "AUTH,CATALOG,PAYMENT,CONTACT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --prefix "[{name}] {time}" --time-format "HH:mm:ss" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix service-catalog" "npm run dev --prefix payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix contact-service"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix service-catalog && npm install --prefix payment-service && npm install --prefix contact-service
scripts.build-all: npm run build --prefix auth-service && npm run build --prefix service-catalog && npm run build --prefix payment-service && npm run build --prefix contact-service
